tldr: North Node in cancer: growth through care, belonging, emotional honesty, and private safety.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop care, belonging, emotional honesty, and private safety. The South Node in capricorn shows the familiar route: overachievement, emotional austerity, and proving worth through control. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to build a life that can hold feeling.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices care, belonging, emotional honesty, and private safety in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in capricorn can pull the person back into overachievement, emotional austerity, and proving worth through control.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
